Asia King Travel was founded in March 2007 . We specialise in personalised service and have deliberately remained specific in what we do rather than expand into a big outfit. We cater for a niche market while providing excellent value for money. Our head office includes management, sales, production and our marketing department in Hanoi. Our operations offices are throughout Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia. We offer tailor-made individual tours and private group tours, incentives tours as well as soft trekking and cycling tours. We have proven success Over the past 19 years and are always striving to improve our service quality by creating new and interesting travel products, discovering new destinations and new activities to meet the expectations of customers and professional partners. Our customers include travellers and partners from France, USA, Australia and various European countries. What is Asia King Travel mean? Asia King Travel doesn’t mean the luxury travel service for the high ranking people like the people thought. Asia King Travel means simply the best quality of travel service for customers who book the tour to the part of Asia. For us the customers are the most important, they like “the kings“. And we try to serve them as “the kings”, "Asia King ". We are aware of the best marketing solution for our travel business, our future. It’s quality of the service which makes customer satisfaction. What credentials we have ? You will feel worry about money may be lost, unsafe. Please bear in mind that your money is fully protected and covered by National Tourism Administration of Vietnam because our business is fully licensed by Vietnam business law and National Tourism Administration of Vietnam. You can get a better feel about who we are, and build confidence in our company, we've prepared below some of our credentials. Utilizing this information, you can "check us out" and confirm for yourself the legitimacy of our company. What do we do? We specialise in providing a ’tailor-made’ travel service to customers who are looking for that ‘perfect’ holiday. This is achieved by collaborating closely with our customers in order to clearly identify their needs. This guarantees that every service we deliver aligns specifically with the travel desires of those we are here to serve.
